lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arranged in roughly vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters. A central column contains three distinct nodes, with the medial node exhibiting the highest pixel intensity. Flanking columns show 3-4 nodes with decreasing intensity towards the anterior and posterior edges of the frame.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like configuration where the blobs serve as anchor nodes within the lighter vertical regions.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-value pixels on the superior edge and a shadow-induced low-value region on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent V-shaped angular indentation or structural fold is present in the central region of the flank, causing a significant localized depression and disruption of the surrounding spot pattern.
